items.title: Resource Label Group joins default ranks after missing interest payments on leveraged loan
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings on Nov. 23 downgraded RLG Holdings, the indirect parent of Resource Label Group LLC, to D, from CCC and a negative outlook, after the agency said the company failed to pay interest on its revolver, first-lien term loan and second-lien term loan within the 10-business-day grace periods following their Oct. 30 due dates. items.summary: Buffett once held hundreds of positions, yet only a tiny few have survived a decade. Coca-Cola, American Express and Moody's earned their spots, but one of them just missed earnings and another is sinking this year. Why does Berkshire still hold on?

items.title: Moody’s lifts Victoria’s Secret outlook to positive on stronger credit metrics
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings revised its outlook on Victoria's Secret & Co (NYSE:VSXY) to positive from stable on Friday, signaling growing confidence in the retailer’s operational turnaround and strengthening credit profile. While affirming the company’s Ba3 corporate family rating alongside its senior secured and unsecured debt ratings, the agency also upgraded Victoria’s Secret’s speculative-grade liquidity rating to SGL-1 from SGL-2.
